entries.dialogueText: "Well, Mom and Deana... you kind of brought that on yourself."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Well...""
entries.dialogueText: "Well..."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I've been talking to Mom. About wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been talking to Mom. About why she left."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I've been the laughing stock of Ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been the laughing stock of Holsord State since the news came out about how I got in."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc winced."
entries.dialogueText: Franc winced.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Look, I don't know the full story.""
entries.dialogueText: "Look, I don't know the full story."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""But if it's anything like what she..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if it's anything like what she said, it was bad."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I didn't mean to hit her.""
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't mean to hit her."
entries.menuText: "I didn't mean to hit her."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Curtan Leste made me do it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Curtan Leste made me do it."
entries.menuText: "Curtan Leste made me do it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Assembly members would've eate..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Assembly members would've eaten her alive if I'd let her work with Ciara."
entries.menuText: "The Assembly members would've eaten her alive if I'd let her work with Ciara."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I had to veto that bill. There wer..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had to veto that bill. There were bigger forces at work."
entries.menuText: "I had to veto that bill. There were bigger forces at work."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Come on, Dad. This was the one thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, Dad. This was the one thing she wanted out of your presidency, and you took it away from her."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I've been learning a lot about wom..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been learning a lot about women's rights at university. I mean, I'm not one of those crazy 'male feminists', but I can sympathize."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""It's wrong that you always treated..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's wrong that you always treated me so well while putting her down."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sordland is counting on me. I won'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland is counting on me. I won't let the country down just because your classmates are calling you names."
entries.menuText: "Sordland is counting on me. I won't let the country down just because your classmates are calling you names."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""This was never about Sordland! It..."
entries.dialogueText: "This was never about Sordland! It was only ever about you! God, Dad, can't you see that?"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""It doesn't matter what you meant!""
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't matter what you meant!"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Well, the thing with Mom... you ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, the thing with Mom... you kind of brought that on yourself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Franc, I know. I've been regrettin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Franc, I know. I've been regretting it every day."
entries.menuText: "Franc, I know. I've been regretting it every day."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I don't know if that's enough.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know if that's enough."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Great. So my whole family hates me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Great. So my whole family hates me now."
entries.menuText: "Great. So my whole family hates me now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're too young to understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're too young to understand."
entries.menuText: "You're too young to understand."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Please, Franc. I've lost everyone..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Franc. I've lost everyone else. I can't lose you too."
entries.menuText: "Please, Franc. I've lost everyone else. I can't lose you too."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I don't hate you. I just need some..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't hate you. I just need some space."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""That's bullshit. Listen, I just ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's bullshit. Listen, I just need some space."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""You're not losing me. I just need..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're not losing me. I just need some space."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Thanks, Dad.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks, Dad."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""You've got that luxury. I don't.""
entries.dialogueText: "You've got that luxury. I don't."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Good luck with the campaign.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck with the campaign."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Good luck with retirement.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck with retirement."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You should go home, Franc. It's la..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should go home, Franc. It's late."
entries.menuText: "You should go home, Franc. It's late."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Stay and have a beer with me?""
entries.dialogueText: "Stay and have a beer with me?"
entries.menuText: "Stay and have a beer with me?"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""No, I've got an exam tomorrow. Tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, I've got an exam tomorrow. Thanks for dinner, Dad."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Yeah, I've got an exam tomorrow an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah, I've got an exam tomorrow anyway. Thanks for dinner, Dad."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After showing Franc to the door, I..."
entries.dialogueText: After showing Franc to the door, I sat and thought for a while.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After showing Franc to the door, I..."
entries.dialogueText: After showing Franc to the door, I sat and thought for a while.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My political career had taken so mu..."
entries.dialogueText: My political career had taken so much away from me. My wife and daughter, and now my son...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And poor Serge..."
entries.dialogueText: And poor Serge...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr...

entries.dialogueText: Where would it end?

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I went to bed, trying not to think..."
entries.dialogueText: I went to bed, trying not to think about my personal relationships. I had far too many other things on my plate.
entries.menuText: Go to bed.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I went up to my office and spun the..."
entries.dialogueText: I went up to my office and spun the globe on my desk.
entries.menuText: Think about leaving the country.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could go to Kyrute. It was the on..."
entries.dialogueText: I could go to Kyrute. It was the one completely neutral country I knew of, and a little house in the mountains wouldn't cost me much.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My entire life had built up to my p..."
entries.dialogueText: My entire life had built up to my presidency. Now, I couldn't wait for it to be over.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I started packing my suitcase. I wa..."
entries.dialogueText: I started packing my suitcase. I wasn't going to stay in Sordland a second longer.
entries.menuText: Leave now.

entries.title: Player_Italic: "I decided to cover up my tracks jus..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to cover up my tracks just in case. There were some documents that needed to be incinerated.
entries.menuText: Leave after covering up your tracks just in case.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was time for a fresh start."
entries.dialogueText: It was time for a fresh start.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I went up to my office and began wr..."
entries.dialogueText: I went up to my office and began writing a letter to my ex-wife. Maybe after my retirement, we'd finally be able to work things out.
entries.menuText: Write a letter to Monica.
